summary: Tested new lead management features: Pause/Resume endpoints, CSV Export, Team Members endpoint, and Approvals Center WebSocket status. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified - Export CSV button visible, Import CSV button visible, Pause Lead option in row actions, Approvals Center shows 'Connecting...' instead of 'Offline'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new lead management features verified. Pause/Resume endpoints work correctly with proper status validation. CSV export returns proper CSV with headers. Team-members endpoint accessible by sales role. Approvals Center WebSocket shows 'Connecting...' or 'Live' instead of 'Offline'.

POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/pause.details: Pauses a lead, saves previous_status, returns success message with previous_status

POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/resume.details: Resumes a paused lead, restores previous status

POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/pause on alrea.details: Returns 400 error when trying to pause an already paused lead

POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/resume on non-.details: Returns 400 error when trying to resume a non-paused lead

GET /api/leads/export/csv.details: Returns CSV with proper headers (Company Name, Contact Person, Email, Phone, etc.) and data rows

GET /api/leads/team-members.details: Returns list of assignable users with id, full_name, email, role fields. Accessible by sales role (EMP003)

Leads page Export CSV button.details: Export CSV button visible in Leads page header with data-testid='csv-download-btn'

Leads page Import CSV button.details: Import CSV button visible next to Export CSV with data-testid='csv-upload-btn'

Leads page row actions Pause/Resume.details: Row actions menu shows 'Pause Lead' for non-paused leads. Menu includes: View Pipeline, Edit Lead, Reassign Lead, Pause Lead

Approvals Center WebSocket status.details: Shows 'Connecting...' or 'Live' indicator instead of 'Offline'. WebSocket connects to /api/ws/{user_id} and sends subscribe message

elements_verified: Row actions menu with Pause Lead option
Quick views: All Leads, My Leads, New, Hot Deals, Stuck, In Meeting, Closing
